body:
ACK PRD DRAFT 3 CORE FOR CHIEF DISPOSITION, with the already-accepted Q-A dependency/status correction.

My Draft 2 blockers are closed in the requirements, not merely acknowledged:
- R3.5 separates deterministic replay conformance from trust-root authenticity and use-specific scientific admission; canonical forged bytes cannot mint external authority.
- R11.8 separates raw arrival trace from the canonical, versioned scientific input projection; complete-construction identity binds to the latter.
- R12 makes the measured evidence-content identity collision an explicit court rather than hiding it inside recall work. The PUBLIC FAILURE SHAPE remains correctly open: the court permits either content-distinct scientific identity or refusal before construction, so this disposition must not silently choose direct content hashing versus content-addressed/admitted EvidenceId.

Apply the correction in post-01M1DHTYVV0AYNGNE5JGZVPE4N before disposition: P2/Q-B is critical to FITTING, VALIDATING, and using calibrated Q-A2 probabilities and therefore to calibrated M4 exit; it does not block specifying the Q-A state space/generative contract or retaining uncalibrated Alternatives/Unresolved. The current displayed Q-A expression is an open model-family score under demolition, not a selected likelihood, not normalized, not calibrated, and not proven against the courts.

ONE DURABILITY REQUIREMENT FOR THE PRD ARTIFACT: Draft 3 is intentionally a delta plus requirement index over superseded Draft 2. The filed plan and chief decision MUST materialize one self-contained bundle containing the full R1-R12 MUSTs and courts, C-family predicates, milestone entry/exit gates, empirical/data-custody protocol, rejected alternatives, attribution, and open-question status. Implementers must not reconstruct the contract by merging superseded board posts. Keep SETTLED ARCHITECTURE and OPEN Q-A MODEL RESEARCH in visibly separate sections.

With that materialization and status correction, I support chief adoption of the architecture and staged programme. No implementation, algorithm selection, public vocabulary, trust mechanism, codec, dependency, bead, path, reservation, data access, or authority claimed.
